========================================================================
  ObserveX Windows Agent — Installation & Setup Guide
========================================================================

ObserveX Agent collects system hardware metrics (CPU, RAM, Disks, Network, GPU),
running process trees, and Windows Event Logs, streaming them securely in real-time
to your centralized ObserveX server via WebSockets.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
Option 1: Double-Click Launcher (Recommended)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Double-click "run_agent.bat" or "ObserveXAgent.exe".
2. The console window will stay open and display the interactive setup prompt:
   - Server URL: enter your server address (e.g. http://localhost:8000)
   - Enrollment Code: paste the enrollment code generated by your admin (e.g. OX-XXXX-XXXX)
3. Once enrolled, the device is permanently registered in config.yaml and
   will automatically stream telemetry whenever it starts up.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
Option 2: Command Line Enrollment
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Open PowerShell or Command Prompt in this folder and run:

    .\ObserveXAgent.exe --server http://localhost:8000 --enroll OX-XXXX-XXXX

------------------------------------------------------------------------
Options & Flags:
------------------------------------------------------------------------
  --server URL       ObserveX Server URL (default: http://localhost:8000)
  --enroll CODE      Enrollment code for first-time onboarding
  --name NAME        Override device hostname
  --interval SECS    Telemetry stream interval in seconds (default: 2.0)
  -h, --help         Show help menu

Need help? Contact your ObserveX organization administrator.
========================================================================
